Search examplesFilters

[![FastFlow Anomaly Detector](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/anomaly-detection/fastflow-anomaly-detector/image.png)\\
\\
Anomaly Detection\\
\\
**FastFlow Anomaly Detector** \\
\\
Flags surface defects on parts in one RTSP stream with an anomaly model trained on good parts only, and sends Insight the video with a defect heatmap drawn on it.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/anomaly-detection%2Ffastflow-anomaly-detector) [![PatchCore Anomaly Detector](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/anomaly-detection/patchcore-anomaly-detector/image.png)\\
\\
Anomaly Detection\\
\\
**PatchCore Anomaly Detector** \\
\\
Detects visual anomalies in industrial images or video using a compiled WideResNet-50 patch-feature extractor and a host-side coreset memory bank calibrated from your own known-good images.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/anomaly-detection%2Fpatchcore-anomaly-detector) [![MIPI Camera Capture](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/benchmarking/mipi-camera-capture/image.png)\\
\\
Benchmarking\\
\\
**MIPI Camera Capture** \\
\\
Captures NV12 frames from a MIPI camera and saves selected frames with timing and luminance diagnostics. It uses Neat CameraInput with a zero-copy DMA-BUF path.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/benchmarking%2Fmipi-camera-capture) [![MIPI Multi-Model](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/benchmarking/mipi-multi-model/image.png)\\
\\
Benchmarking\\
\\
**MIPI Multi-Model** \\
\\
Runs a selected detection, pose, segmentation, classification, or depth model on a strict zero-copy MIPI camera. Detection and segmentation can also stream video and metadata to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/benchmarking%2Fmipi-multi-model) [![Model Benchmark](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/benchmarking/model-benchmark/image.png)\\
\\
Benchmarking\\
\\
**Model Benchmark** \\
\\
Measures latency, throughput, power, and energy for any compiled model package, then saves the results as JSON.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/benchmarking%2Fmodel-benchmark) [![Image Classification Explorer](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/classification/image-classification-explorer/image.jpeg)\\
\\
Image Classification\\
\\
**Image Classification Explorer** \\
\\
Classifies a single image or a folder of images with one or more models and shows predictions,\\
confidence, and where models agree or disagree in a browsable HTML report with JSON and CSV\\
results.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/classification%2Fimage-classification-explorer) [![Depth Estimator](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/depth-estimation/depth-estimator/image.png)\\
\\
Depth Estimation\\
\\
**Depth Estimator** \\
\\
Creates visual depth maps for a folder of images with Depth Anything V2.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/depth-estimation%2Fdepth-estimator) [![Parallel Apps in Docker](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/docker/parallel-apps/image.png)\\
\\
Docker\\
\\
**Parallel Apps in Docker** \\
\\
Runs six Neat applications side by side in Docker containers on one Modalix DevKit, each sending live video and results to its own Insight channel.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/docker%2Fparallel-apps) [![Face Detector](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/face-detection/face-detector/image.png)\\
\\
Face Detection\\
\\
**Face Detector** \\
\\
Finds faces in a folder of images with RetinaFace, then saves annotated results with confidence scores and five facial landmarks.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/face-detection%2Fface-detector) [![Single-Stream Thermal Face Detector](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/face-detection/single-stream-thermal-face-detector/image.png)\\
\\
Face Detection\\
\\
**Single-Stream Thermal Face Detector** \\
\\
Detects faces and five facial landmarks in a live thermal RTSP stream with YOLOv5s-Face, then sends the overlay to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/face-detection%2Fsingle-stream-thermal-face-detector) [![SuperPoint Feature Extractor](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/feature-extraction/superpoint-feature-extractor/image.png)\\
\\
Feature Extraction\\
\\
**SuperPoint Feature Extractor** \\
\\
Finds SuperPoint feature points in an RTSP stream and sends the annotated video to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/feature-extraction%2Fsuperpoint-feature-extractor) [![Detection-to-VLM Assistant](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/genai/detection-to-vlm-assistant/image.png)\\
\\
GenAI\\
\\
**Detection-to-VLM Assistant** \\
\\
Detects people in a live RTSP stream with YOLO26 and sends video to Insight. It can also crop the highest-confidence person and ask a configured vision-language model about them.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/genai%2Fdetection-to-vlm-assistant) [![Neat GenAI Studio](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/genai/neat-genai-studio/image.png)\\
\\
GenAI\\
\\
**Neat GenAI Studio** \\
\\
Runs language, vision-language, and speech models on a Modalix device as the board-side backend for the GenAI tab in Neat Insight, with an OpenAI-compatible API.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/genai%2Fneat-genai-studio) [![Multi Stream Multi Model](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/multi-model/multi-stream-multi-model/image.png)\\
\\
Multi Model\\
\\
**Multi Stream Multi Model** \\
\\
Runs a different model on each of up to four RTSP cameras in one process, and sends every camera's video and its own detection, segmentation, or pose metadata to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/multi-model%2Fmulti-stream-multi-model) [![DETR Object Detector](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/object-detection/detr-object-detector/image.png)\\
\\
Object Detection\\
\\
**DETR Object Detector** \\
\\
Detects objects in a folder of images with DETR and saves annotated images with class labels and confidence scores.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/object-detection%2Fdetr-object-detector) [![High-Density Multi-Stream Object Detector](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/object-detection/high-density-multi-stream-object-detector/image.png)\\
\\
Object Detection\\
\\
**High-Density Multi-Stream Object Detector** \\
\\
Runs one YOLO26 detector across 20, 30, or 60 RTSP streams and sends synchronized video and detection metadata to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/object-detection%2Fhigh-density-multi-stream-object-detector) [![Multi-Stream OBB Detector](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/object-detection/multi-stream-obb-detector/image.png)\\
\\
Object Detection\\
\\
**Multi-Stream OBB Detector** \\
\\
Runs YOLO26 oriented-box detection on up to four RTSP streams of top-down aerial video and sends each stream's video and rotated boxes to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/object-detection%2Fmulti-stream-obb-detector) [![Multi-Stream Object Detector](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/object-detection/multi-stream-object-detector/image.png)\\
\\
Object Detection\\
\\
**Multi-Stream Object Detector** \\
\\
Runs YOLO26 object detection across multiple RTSP streams and sends each stream's video and detection metadata to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/object-detection%2Fmulti-stream-object-detector) [![PCB Defect Detector](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/object-detection/pcb-defect-detector/image.jpg)\\
\\
Object Detection\\
\\
**PCB Defect Detector** \\
\\
Batch visual inspection of printed circuit boards with a custom-trained YOLO26n\\
detector. Every image in a folder is run on the MLA and saved back annotated with\\
defect boxes and labels.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/object-detection%2Fpcb-defect-detector) [![PCIe High-Density Multi-Stream Object Detector](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/object-detection/pcie-high-density-multi-stream-object-detector/image.png)\\
\\
Object Detection\\
\\
**PCIe High-Density Multi-Stream Object Detector** \\
\\
Runs YOLO26 object detection across many RTSP streams using a host and Modalix PCIe card, then sends synchronized results to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/object-detection%2Fpcie-high-density-multi-stream-object-detector) [![RF-DETR Detection and Segmentation](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/object-detection/rfdetr-detection-segmentation/image.jpg)\\
\\
Object Detection\\
\\
**RF-DETR Detection and Segmentation** \\
\\
Run RF-DETR detection or instance segmentation on one H.264, H.265, or MJPEG RTSP stream and view the result in Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/object-detection%2Frfdetr-detection-segmentation) [![Single-Stream Object Detector](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/object-detection/single-stream-object-detector/image.png)\\
\\
Object Detection\\
\\
**Single-Stream Object Detector** \\
\\
Detects objects in one RTSP or MJPEG stream with YOLO26 and sends synchronized H.264 video and detection metadata to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/object-detection%2Fsingle-stream-object-detector) [![SSD-MobileNet Object Detector](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/object-detection/ssd-mobilenet-object-detector/image.png)\\
\\
Object Detection\\
\\
**SSD-MobileNet Object Detector** \\
\\
Detects objects in a folder of images with SSD MobileNet, saves annotated PNGs, and can write the same detections to a JSON report.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/object-detection%2Fssd-mobilenet-object-detector) [![YOLO26 Object Detector](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/object-detection/yolo26-object-detector/image.png)\\
\\
Object Detection\\
\\
**YOLO26 Object Detector** \\
\\
Detects objects in a folder of images with YOLO26 and saves copies annotated with boxes, labels, and confidence scores.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/object-detection%2Fyolo26-object-detector) [![Multi-Stream BlazePose 3D](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/pose-estimation/multi-stream-blazepose3d/image.png)\\
\\
Pose Estimation\\
\\
**Multi-Stream BlazePose 3D** \\
\\
Tracks people in up to four RTSP streams with YOLO26 and BlazePose Heavy, then sends 2D landmarks and 3D world landmarks for each frame to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/pose-estimation%2Fmulti-stream-blazepose3d) [![Multi-Stream Pose Estimator](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/pose-estimation/multi-stream-pose-estimator/image.png)\\
\\
Pose Estimation\\
\\
**Multi-Stream Pose Estimator** \\
\\
Estimates 17-point COCO poses in multiple RTSP streams with YOLO26 Pose and sends synchronized video and pose metadata to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/pose-estimation%2Fmulti-stream-pose-estimator) [![EfficientSAM3 Promptable Segmenter](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/segmentation/efficientsam3-promptable-segmenter/image.png)\\
\\
Segmentation\\
\\
**EfficientSAM3 Promptable Segmenter** \\
\\
Segments whatever a text prompt names, such as a person or a red car, in one RTSP H.264 or H.265 stream with EfficientSAM3 and sends H.264 video and mask outlines to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/segmentation%2Fefficientsam3-promptable-segmenter) [![Single Stream Instance Segmenter](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/segmentation/single-stream-instance-segmenter/image.png)\\
\\
Segmentation\\
\\
**Single Stream Instance Segmenter** \\
\\
Segments objects in one RTSP or MJPEG stream with a YOLO26 or YOLOv8 model and sends synchronized H.264 video and mask metadata to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/segmentation%2Fsingle-stream-instance-segmenter) [![Multi-Stream Tracker](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/tracking/multi-stream-tracker/image.png)\\
\\
Tracking\\
\\
**Multi-Stream Tracker** \\
\\
Tracks up to five object classes across multiple RTSP streams with YOLO26, each class with its own ByteTrack tracker settings. Every track gets a stable ID, sent to Insight with its class label.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/tracking%2Fmulti-stream-tracker) [![YOLO26 Tiny-Drone Tracker](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/example-assets/tracking/yolo26-tiny-drone-tracker/image.jpg)\\
\\
Tracking\\
\\
**YOLO26 Tiny-Drone Tracker** \\
\\
Track tiny drones across up to four RTSP streams with YOLO26 and publish\\
annotated video plus per-stream tracking metadata to Insight.](https://developer.sima.ai/examples/app/tracking%2Fyolo26-tiny-drone-tracker)
